hypothesis: A shared multiscale substrate pigment, richer soil detail, darker olive blade bodies and localized UV-normalized tips connect the ground and existing grass representation.
scope: One coordinated implementation pass in two prairie-specific files. Horizon, matte, tree specimens, key light and shadow fields retained.
implementation: World-space irregular grass/soil swaths use the existing community field with fine warped breakup; existing sediment artwork provides substrate texture and small bump response.
Terrain and plant roots share the same pigment function and soil sampler. Root color stays continuous; green/olive body transition and gold are confined to upper blade UVs.
Short cover extends from foreground pockets toward the middle opening; tall framing geometry retained. 240 additional short clump instances in the existing grass batch, no new draw calls.

review.reviewer: Primary Codex actual matched hero and elevated image interpretation
observations: Foreground grasses are deeper olive/green rather than uniformly pale straw; small warm tips and yellow flowers stand out.
Irregular warm soil areas appear within cooler vegetated ground, especially legible from above.
Short cover helps blend the staging opening into surrounding growth.
Human-height shaded center remains subdued and fine texture is still not as rich as the concept. No final artistic approval claimed.

learning.principle: Normalize tip-pigment masks to blade UV length rather than absolute plant height.
learning.cause: Confirmed: the previous meter-based tip mask spread gold too far down taller blades.
learning.result: Experimentally supported here: deeper bodies and more selective tip color.
learning.scope: Prairie experiment; not promoted globally or human-approved.

learning.principle: Coordinate soil breakup and root pigment through one world-space function.
learning.result: Shared roots and surface color remain coherent, but the image shows that broad pigment patches alone do not finish fine ground detail.
learning.scope: Experimental evidence, not a universal palette or approval.

validation.protected: No protected recipe, shared renderer, ecological resolver or asset edited. No full regression suite run.
